{{Top}}
The '''Archaeological Research Council''' was a committee of [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] archaeologists on the world of [[Kallidah/Legends|Kallidah]]. The Research Council established a [[Polis Massa Research Base|Research Base]] on the largest asteroid remnant of ancient [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], intending to find an evolutionary link between the Kallidahin and the [[Eellayin/Legends|Eellayin]] natives of Polis Massa.
